hypothesis_findings.H1: No incorrect renewal/publication observed in traced original cases; not universally falsified.
hypothesis_findings.H2: Statement-time margins stayed positive; client commit durations measured. Failed gated case lacks causal DB timings.
hypothesis_findings.H3: Original-case event-loop maxima 9.642–27.394 ms; no correlation with loss. Failed B gated interval was not monitored.
hypothesis_findings.H4: Full summary and broad runs failed different tests; final broad passed. Suite/load causality unproven.
hypothesis_findings.H5: Original-case pool waits up to 5.056 ms; no measured causal contention. Failed cases lack corresponding state evidence.
hypothesis_findings.H6: Gated observer awaits an extra query; transient retry assumes 20 ms. Susceptibilities visible, but these new failures are not causally attributed.
hypothesis_findings.H7: Observer effects possible; C gated query max 1.648 ms and its test passed. No systematic observer effect demonstrated.
hypothesis_findings.H8: Fencing/drain/admission/rollback tests passed; expected late heartbeat refusal after completed publication occurred without unsafe admission.
hypothesis_findings.H9: Original event not repeated, but additional unresolved failures prevent qualified one-time-anomaly closure.

limitations: Five instrumented original observations plus one uninstrumented original observation are not IID reliability samples.
DB margins are statement-time measurements, not server commit-time measurements; client COMMIT request/ack durations are measured.
The B-summary gated failure lacks event-level tracing; C added passive observation only, within the original run/iteration budget.
Instrumentation may alter scheduling/IO; no exact historical root cause or recurrence probability established.
Offline legacy exact-510-TS full_851_regression_verified flag remains false; 512 actual TS tests and all executed offline checks passed.

measurement_addendum.change: Temporary C-only observer on existing gated case; record its heartbeat observation SELECT duration, SQL result clock/margin, timer/commit/pool events and drain. No new runs, iterations, load, delays, assertions, predicates or budgets.
